Intended biology: Pre-existing T-cell-inflamed, IFN-linked but checkpoint-suppressed adaptive immune state.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: DIRECT: evaluated in the same I-SPY2 expression biomarker program.
Why included: Positive benchmark: a mature, widely used immune-inflammatory signature lets the framework test whether an apparently strong ICI biomarker is treatment-specific rather than merely generally pCR-associated.

Intended biology: Chemokine-rich immune aggregation/TLS-like recruitment program spanning T, B and myeloid trafficking.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: DIRECT: developed/evaluated across I-SPY2 arms and re-evaluated in the 2024 I-SPY2 multi-platform study.
Why included: Positive benchmark for treatment-specificity; also intentionally source-shared, making it useful for CSI/source qualification.

Intended biology: Mixed immune activation and immune-regulatory/TIL-associated program.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: DIRECT: explicitly evaluated in the I-SPY2 multi-platform biomarker study.
Why included: Tests a classic TIL-associated signature whose biology is intentionally mixed across cell types and activation/suppression states.

Intended biology: Compact IFNγ/checkpoint-activation program.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: BIOLOGICAL overlap only; not confirmed as an exact duplicate in the Campbell 2024 main-text I-SPY2 list.
Why included: Compact high-coherence immune-state control for distinguishing generic chemo-responsiveness from ICI-specific interaction.

Intended biology: Tumor immune cytolytic activity.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed in the 2024 main-text audit.
Why included: Minimal effector-function module provides a low-complexity contrast to multi-lineage inflammatory signatures.

Intended biology: Antigen processing/presentation plus IFN signaling associated with durvalumab-arm response in GeparNuevo.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Directly targets the question whether antigen-presentation/IFN biology carries ICI-specific information beyond general immune activation.

Intended biology: Activated T/B-cell and cytokine program in immune-rich basal-like TNBC.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Independent durvalumab-derived candidate already tested against placebo in GeparNuevo; strong comparator for treatment-specificity qualification.

Intended biology: Spatially resolved tertiary lymphoid structure program with B-cell, priming, T-cell and immune-response components.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: DIRECT: the same signature was projected to GSE194040/I-SPY2 and associated with pCR.
Why included: Spatial positive benchmark. It should not be presented as a new GSE194040 discovery; instead it tests whether spatial identity and treatment interaction are preserved.

Intended biology: Expanded anti-PD1-experienced CD8 T cells combining cytotoxicity, homing and exhaustion.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed; overlaps conceptually with TIS/cytolytic biology.
Why included: Temporal state core: asks whether a treatment-induced CD8 state is already measurable at baseline and whether bulk abundance obscures state biology.

Intended biology: Expanded CD4 Th1/Tfh-like anti-PD1 response state.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Separates helper/Tfh-like state from broader TLS and IFN signatures and is well suited to abundance-versus-state qualification.

Intended biology: Undifferentiated pre-effector/memory T-cell state inversely associated with post-PD1 clonal expansion.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Provides a mechanistically distinct T-cell state that may be favorable prognostically yet not represent treatment-engaged cytotoxicity.

Intended biology: Inhibitory macrophage phenotype inversely associated with T-cell expansion after anti-PD1.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Compact myeloid resistance state for testing source specificity and temporal persistence.

Intended biology: SPP1/TREM2 extracellular-matrix/lipid-associated macrophage phenotype enriched in nonresponders.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Strong TNBC-specific resistance biology and a deliberate source/state challenge because SPP1/FN1/C3 can be expressed outside macrophages.

Intended biology: Pro-inflammatory macrophage phenotype enriched in responders to paclitaxel+atezolizumab.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Paired opposite-polarity myeloid program to the SPP1/TREM2 core; ideal for state and treatment-context qualification.

Intended biology: Inflammatory/recruited monocyte identity.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Abundance-dominated candidate useful as a built-in measurement-control for distinguishing recruited-cell quantity from within-cell activation.

Intended biology: Suppressive/nonresponder-associated myeloid program reported in the TNBC PD-L1-blockade single-cell context.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Represents a suppressive myeloid alternative to SPP1/TREM2 and tests whether distinct resistance states collapse into one bulk macrophage signal.

Intended biology: Inflamed spatial immunophenotype associated with anti-PD1 response and favorable outcome.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed; substantial biological overlap with immune/TLS benchmarks.
Why included: Tests whether a spatial phenotype survives reduction to a bulk transcript score and retains treatment-specific information.

Intended biology: T-cell-excluded collagen/CAF-rich spatial phenotype associated with anti-PD1 resistance.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Key stromal resistance comparator; directly challenges whether bulk ECM intensity is equivalent to spatial T-cell exclusion.

Intended biology: ECM-myCAF / matrix-producing immunosuppressive fibroblast state.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Source-specific stromal core designed to distinguish fibroblast abundance/state from broad ECM signatures; uses positive markers only.

Intended biology: TGFβ-associated myofibroblastic CAF state.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Tests whether a TGFβ-linked CAF state behaves differently from ECM-myCAF despite partial lineage relatedness.

Intended biology: Detoxification/inflammatory CAF state and direct precursor-like transition toward ECM-myCAF.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: Creates a stromal-state contrast with ECM/TGFβ myCAF; useful for temporal plasticity qualification rather than simple CAF abundance.

Intended biology: MHC-II transcriptional program motivated by tumor-specific MHC-II as an ICI-benefit biomarker.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: ASSAY/BIOLOGICAL overlap with I-SPY2: original evidence included tumor-specific HLA-DR/MHC-II protein, not this bulk-RNA 4-gene score.
Why included: Deliberate source-qualification stress test: a tumor-specific biological concept may become APC/B-cell/myeloid dominated when measured in bulk RNA.

Intended biology: Cross-presenting cDC1 abundance/identity.
I-SPY2 overlap audit: No exact direct I-SPY2 duplication confirmed.
Why included: cDC1 increased in responsive TNBC after PD-L1 blockade and is central to breast antitumor T-cell priming; two platform-available cDC1 genes avoid outcome-based gene selection.
